hooks.command: COMMAND=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf ~|rm -rf \$HOME|dd if=|> ?/dev/sd|mkfs|:\(\)\{ :\|:& \};:|curl.*\|.*bash|wget.*\|.*sh|chmod 777|sudo rm)'; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected!' >&2; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if [[ "$FILE" == *".env"* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *"package-lock.json"* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *"poetry.lock"* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *".git/"* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *"claudecodeenv/"* ]]; then echo "🔒 BLOCKED: $FILE is protected" >&2; exit 2; fi
